bullets: Developed and enforced comprehensive information security policies and procedures, ensuring data protection and regulatory compliance.

Led Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) initiatives, assuring adherence to PCI DSS, ISO 27001, regulatory (RBI) circulars/guidelines and other pertinent standards, achieving a 100% compliance rate.
Facing client’s audits such as third-party risk assessment (TPRA), digital forensic readiness assessment (DFRA), digital payment security controls (DPSC), etc.
Conducted vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on network infrastructure and web applications, identifying and mitigating over thousands of vulnerabilities in each quarter.
Streamlining vulnerability assessment activity and minimizing the risk almost by 80% and its tracking.
Administered security patch management to ensure timely deployment of updates across all company systems, achieving 98% patch compliance.
Regulatory and compliance audits such as ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, RBI inspection, RBI system audits
Performing quarterly configuration review of entire internal infrastructure along with access review of users.
Driving quarterly penetration testing on all external facing application from approved scanning vendor.
Exploring solutions to enhance security posture of the organization and process streamlining.
Driving other quarterly and half yearly exercises such as segmentation, internal penetration testing, external penetration testing, audit of BBPS systems,
Reviewing SOC alert and its use cases for its effectiveness on weekly basis.
Review of policies, procedure and baseline documents on annual basis.
Performing vendor risk assessment on annual basis.
Generate regular reports for senior leadership, highlighting security metrics, risks, and performance of security initiatives.

Coordinated with respective stakeholders to manage Change Management, Incident Management, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), Security Operations Center (SOC/SIEM) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP)/IT Disaster Recovery (IT DR) activities
Governing IT Infrastructure security operations to deliver it at its best with ensuring all compliant process on it place.
Managing vendor support ensuring support availability to continue security operations.
Reviewing VA, CA and PT observations of applications to handle the same over web application firewall.
Performing review of security polices on periodic basis to fine tune implemented policy and enhance security control.
Active team member in the DR and cluster drills.
Primarily looks upon the cyber security of the organization.
Driving VAPT and red teaming projects followed by third party engagement, assessment, observation closure and reassessment to attain compliance.
Forensic evidence reporting and explaining root cause of the incidents to the government superiors such as IAS, IPS, etc.
Information protection responsibilities such as network architecture review, access control, privilege control, event monitoring, business continuity planning.
Ensuring effective implementation of Information Security Management System.
Cyber and Information security certifications and compliance such as audits from CERT-In empaneled organization, VAPT, ISO, SOC2, STQC, CMMI.
Evaluating security solutions and its implementation to leverage the security posture of the organization.
Third party technology risk assessment from engagement to implementation and so on.
Addressing security related queries and concerns of clients in the engagement meets.
